question: Khelo India University Games - 2021 were hosted by _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Khelo India University Games - 2021 were hosted by **Karnataka.**
 
• Governor of Karnataka Shri TC Gehlot and Union Sports Minister Shri Anurag Singh Thakur launched the l**ogo, jersey, mascot and anthem **of Khelo India University Games 2021 in Bengaluru on 1st April 2022.
 
• Gehlot launched the** logo and official mascot of the game Veera.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Khelo India University Games is a** multi-sport event held in India **where athletes from universities across the country compete with each other in different sports events.
 
• Khelo India University games are** conducted annually.**
 
• In February** 2020 Khelo India University Games was hosted by Bhubaneshwar, Odhisa.**
 
• Its headquarters is in **New Delhi.**
 
• The Khelo India University Games is organized by the** Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports and Sports Authority of India (SAI) **along with the Association of Indian Universities, Indian Olympic Association, and National Sports federation.
 
• The Khelo India University Games is the** largest university-level sports competition in India.**
